summary: City Council adopted Official Plan Amendment No. 231 (OPA 231) regarding Employment Areas in December 2013. Official Plan Amendment 231 is currently under appeal before the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal (LPAT), formerly the Ontario Municipal Board (OMB). Since the proclamation of Bill 139 in force as of April 3, 2018, the Ontario Municipal Board has been replaced by the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal. However, the hearing for Official Plan Amendment 231 will be adjudicated under the former system, including legal tests and procedural rules. The Local Planning Appeal Tribunal has scheduled July 9 to 13, 2017 to hear the remaining appeals regarding contested uses in Employment Areas. This report requests direction from City Council for the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal hearing respecting land use compatibility and mitigation issues.
